phase: Author correction of comparator acceptance semantics and strict failure signature verification

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Counterexample A: Test name alone accepted unrelated failure as transfer stage fence
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: In is_transfer_stage_fence, test_transfer_reports_never_shrunk_or_mixed in name accepted unrelated AssertionError as INHERITED_STAGE_TRANSFER
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Removed test-name matching from is_transfer_stage_fence; required explicit stage fence markers and compatible exception type (UnsupportedResourceStage or trigger error)

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Counterexample B: Unknown metadata (None==None) accepted disparate exception types as inherited fallback
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: In compare_failure_details fallback, None==None matching for refusal_code and reached_assertion accepted ValueError vs TypeError as INHERITED_OTHER
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Enforced non-None matching exception types and required concrete refusal_code or reached_assertion signature; rejected None==None fallback

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Category shortcut in admission refusals accepted refusal code mismatch
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: is_admission_refusal lumped PERMISSION_DENIED and INVALID_IDENTIFICATION into INHERITED_ADMISSION_PERMISSION_DENIED without checking refusal code equality
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Enforced identical non-None refusal code equality; explicitly rejected PERMISSION_DENIED vs INVALID_IDENTIFICATION as CHANGED_FAILURE

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: P7 recovery classname matching accepted divergent assertions under None==None
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: is_p7_recovery accepted tests with classname containing 'p7' even if reached assertions differed when refusal_code was None
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Required matching non-None refusal code or matching non-None reached assertion and compatible exception type

broad_regression_summary.changed_failure_reconciliation: In baseline #154, failed at line 411 with AdmissionRefused: PERMISSION_DENIED (unauthenticated context export barrier). In I6-C, export succeeded and failed at line 415 with ExchangeError: resources:INVALID_IDENTIFICATION (envelope wire identification validation barrier). Under strict refusal code matching (PERMISSION_DENIED != INVALID_IDENTIFICATION), this is a genuine CHANGED_FAILURE. PR #168 previously masked this via category shortcut.
